signals.observation: Of 36 student repositories, 20 to 23 hold a substantive write-up for each of weeks 1 to 6, most with readable code. Only 10 hold one for week 7 and 11 for week 8, with almost no readable code.
As of 19 November no repository holds a write-up or build for week 9 or week 10 beyond empty template placeholders.
17 of 36 repositories have no final-project write-up of substance; 19 have one, with a median of about 14 KB.
21 of 36 repositories were last pushed in October. 14 have been pushed since 9 November.

Student groups submitted six public Week 8 pull requests to the course repository that extend the Course Agent with personalization: student-owned memory, a study coach, peer-help matchmaking, and personalized peer builds. 11 repositories hold a week 8 write-up.
6 repositories store weekly builds as zip archives, which the Course Agent's repository reader cannot open; it sees their write-ups but not their code.
